Job Description:
Job Title: Test Data Analyst, Vice President
Location: Pune, India
Role Description
We are seeking a proactive and skilled Assistant Vice President, Test Data Analyst, to join our Corporate Bank. In this role, you will be instrumental in the execution and support of test data management activities, ensuring the provision of high-quality, relevant, and compliant test data for our diverse technology landscape.
You will work closely with Test Data Manager, development and QA teams to facilitate efficient testing cycles, enhance test coverage, and contribute to the delivery of robust and reliable banking applications.
This position requires a strong technical aptitude, an understanding of corporate banking data, and a collaborative spirit.
You will work as part of a cross-functional agile delivery team. You will bring an innovative approach to software development, focusing on using the latest technologies and practices, as part of a relentless focus on business value. You will be someone who sees engineering as team activity, with a predisposition to open code, open discussion and creating a supportive, collaborative environment. You will be ready to contribute to all stages of software delivery, from initial analysis right through to production support.
Your key responsibilities
Data Discovery & Profiling : Assist in the analysis of production data models, volumes, and relationships across various corporate banking systems. Support liaison with Operations teams during the discovery phase to understand data characteristics and usage patterns.
Data Procurement: Execute processes for the secure extraction of production data using specified ETL tools and procedures, adhering to data privacy and security regulations.
Data Masking & Obfuscation: Apply defined data masking and obfuscation techniques to sensitive fields, ensuring data privacy and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) while maintaining data integrity for effective testing. Collaborate with Operations and Information Security as required.
Meaningful Dataset Extraction: Perform extraction of smaller, highly focused, and meaningful datasets as requested by QA and development teams, contributing to faster and more efficient testing.
Synthetic Data Generation: Generate synthetic data based on predefined requirements for critical testing scenarios, including negative testing, edge cases, performance testing, and where production data is insufficient or unavailable.
Data Refresh & Versioning: Perform periodic or on-demand data refreshes in lower environments, ensuring test environments reflect realistic and up-to-date production conditions. Assist in managing versioning of test data sets.
Data Provisioning & Self-Service Support: Support the implementation and maintenance of mechanisms for Quality Assurance (QA) and Development (Dev) teams to provision test data independently. Provide guidance and support to users of test data self-service platforms.
Documentation & Reporting: Maintain comprehensive documentation of test data processes, data models, and masking rules. Generate reports on test data availability, usage, and quality.
Tooling & Automation Support: Assist in the evaluation, implementation, and maintenance of Test Data Management (TDM) tools and technologies, contributing to the automation of data provisioning, masking, and refreshing processes.
Stakeholder Collaboration : Work closely with Development, QA, Operations, and Business Analysts to understand their data requirements and facilitate timely test data delivery.
Your skills and experience
9+ years of experience in Test Data Management (TDM), Data Management, or a related data-centric role, preferably within the financial services industry.
Proven experience with data masking, data subsetting, and synthetic data generation techniques and tools.
Strong understanding of relational databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, DB2) and SQL.
Familiarity with ETL tools and data integration concepts.
Solid understanding of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and information security principles.
Experience with test automation frameworks and methodologies (e.g., Agile, DevOps).
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, complex, and highly regulated environment.
Strong leadership qualities with the ability to influence and collaborate across diverse teams.
Preferred Skills
Hands-on experience with specific TDM tools (e.g., Delphix, Broadcom Test Data Manager, Informatica Test Data Management).
Knowledge of Corporate Banking products and processes (e.g., Payments, Trade Finance, Lending, Securities Services).
Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Perl, Shell) for data manipulation and automation.
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and services.
How we ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

description:
Senior Data Engineer
Opkey | Series B Funded | Noida, India (In-Office) | Full-Time

The Opportunity
Opkey, a Series B funded enterprise application lifecycle management platform, is looking
for a Senior Data Engineer to join our team in Noida. We need someone who can build and
scale the data infrastructure pipelines, storage systems, and processing engines that
powers our platform.
Were not pitching a vision were scaling a reality. Our systems already process hundreds
of gigabytes of enterprise data. Now we need an engineer who can make that infrastructure
handle 10x more, 10x faster, with bulletproof reliability. This is your chance to be part of
building something that will define a category.

About Us
Opkey is redefining how enterprises manage the lifecycle of their most critical applications.
Weve built the platform that takes organizations from Design to Configure to Test to Train,
powered by agentic AI.
Our customers already include Fortune 500 companies and top global system
integrators. They trust us with hundreds of gigabytes of their most sensitive enterprise
data payroll files, configuration exports, test results because weve proven we can handle
it.
Were already doing what others are only talking about. Our pipelines already process
massive payroll files in real-time. Our systems already normalize chaotic enterprise data
formats into clean, queryable structures. Our infrastructure already powers AI and analytics
that enterprises depend on.
Now were scaling. And we need exceptional people to help us go from category creator to
category leader.
This is founder mode, not corporate mode. We move fast, we solve hard problems, and
we ship things that matter.

Why This Role Matters
Data scientists cant build models on broken pipelines. Analysts cant find insights in dirty
data. The entire intelligence layer of our platform depends on rock-solid data infrastructure.
Youll build the foundation everything else depends on.
Youll design the pipelines that ingest data from dozens of enterprise formats. Youll build the
systems that diff millions of records in seconds. Youll create the infrastructure that lets our
data scientists focus on algorithms instead of wrestling with data quality.
When a Fortune 500 company validates their payroll migration, your infrastructure makes
that possible. When our ML models predict configuration failures, theyre running on
pipelines you built.
This is already happening at Opkey. Youll help us scale it to the world.

What Youll Do
Youll join a team thats already built production data infrastructure handling enterprise-scale
workloads. Your job is to make it faster, more reliable, and ready for the next order of
magnitude:
Build & Optimize Data Pipelines: Design and implement ETL/ELT pipelines that
ingest data from diverse enterprise sources Excel files, CSVs, API exports,
database extracts, proprietary formats and transform it into clean, queryable
structures.
Design High-Performance Comparison Engines: Build systems that diff massive
datasets payroll files with millions of records, configuration exports with thousands
of parameters and surface differences in real-time.
Architect Scalable Data Storage: Design and manage data warehouses, data
lakes, and databases that handle terabytes of enterprise data. Make decisions about
partitioning, indexing, and storage formats.
Ensure Data Quality & Reliability: Implement validation, monitoring, and alerting
systems that catch data issues before they affect downstream consumers. Build self
healing, observable pipelines.
Enable Analytics & ML Teams: Partner with data scientists to build the
infrastructure they need feature stores, training data pipelines, model serving
infrastructure.
Scale for Growth: Design systems that can handle 10x the data without 10x the cost
or complexity. Think ahead about bottlenecks and architect around them.

Skills & Qualifications
Required Technical Skills
Python for Data Engineering: 4+ years of production experience writing clean,
maintainable, performant Python code for data processing and pipeline development
SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL complex queries, query optimization,
understanding execution plans. You can look at a slow query and know how to fix it.
Data Pipeline Development: Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines that
run reliably in production. Youve designed pipelines that process millions of records
without failing.
Distributed Computing: Deep knowledge of frameworks like Apache Spark for
large-scale data processing. You understand partitioning strategies, shuffle
optimization, and memory management.
Data Modeling & Warehousing: Strong foundation in data modeling star
schemas, slowly changing dimensions, normalization vs. denormalization tradeoffs.
Database Technologies: Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL,
MySQL) and data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery). You know when to
use each.

Nice to Have
Experience with streaming data systems (Kafka, Kinesis)
Cloud platform expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Knowledge of orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect)
Background in data comparison/diffing algorithms
Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Exposure to enterprise data formats and systems

Mindset & Approach
Reliability-Obsessed: Youve been paged at 2am, and youve built systems that
dont page you at 2am. You understand what it takes to run production infrastructure.
Systems Thinker: You see how individual components fit into the larger
architecture. You make tradeoffs that optimize for the whole system.
Ownership Mentality: You dont treat data quality as someone elses problem. You
own the pipeline end-to-end from ingestion to the data scientists query.
Pragmatic Engineer: You know when to build for flexibility and when to optimize for
performance. You dont chase shiny tools when proven ones work better.
Founder Mentality: You thrive in ambiguity, make architectural decisions with
incomplete information, and care about outcomes over perfect documentation.

What Were NOT Looking For
Engineers who only want to work with cutting-edge tools regardless of fit
People who treat data quality as someone elses problem
Those who need a detailed roadmap handed to them
Candidates whove never owned production systems end-to-end

What We Offer
Competitive salary + meaningful equity in a company thats already winning
The chance to architect data infrastructure that Fortune 500 companies depend on
A team that values speed, ownership, and results over politics
Direct impact your pipelines will process enterprise data at a scale most engineers
never see
The opportunity to be part of history building the data foundation that powers
how enterprises manage their most critical applications

Weve proven our infrastructure works. Now we need someone to scale it to
the world.
Apply with your resume and a brief note about the most challenging data pipeline youve
built.
Opkey is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive
environment for all employees.

Job Title: Data Engineer - Azure Fabric, PySpark & Migration Specialist
Position Summary
We are seeking a Data Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Fabric , PySpark , and data pipeline orchestration to lead the migration of existing tools and workflows from Azure Synapse and SQL Server stored procedures into a modern data platform built on Microsoft Fabric . A deep understanding of distributed data processing , Apache Airflow , and cloud-native data engineering is essential.
This role will be pivotal in transforming our data infrastructure, with hands-on responsibilities in pipeline development , data modeling , and performance optimization using tools such as PySpark , Delta Lake , and OneLake . Key
Responsibilities
Lead the migration of legacy data pipelines and stored procedures from Azure Synapse and SQL Server into Microsoft Fabric using PySpark and Fabric-native capabilities.
Design and implement PySpark-based transformations within Fabric pipelines to support scalable, efficient data processing.
Develop, schedule, and monitor workflows using Apache Airflow , and support the transition to integrated orchestration in Fabric where applicable.
Refactor and optimize existing ADF (Azure Data Factory) pipelines, integrating them into Fabric or coordinating them with Airflow as needed.
Implement and maintain robust dimensional data models and support data marts optimized for analytics and reporting.
Leverage Delta Lake format for reliable, performant data storage and support transactional workloads in OneLake .
Ensure data quality, lineage, and governance through best practices in data engineering and observability.
Collaborate closely with architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver trusted, timely, and high-quality data solutions.
Participate in DevOps processes including version control, automated testing, and CI/CD for data workflows.
Required Qualifications
4+ years of experience in data engineering with a strong focus on PySpark and distributed data processing.
Proven experience with Apache Airflow for data pipeline orchestration.
Solid hands-on experience in Azure Fabric , ADF , Azure Synapse , and SQL Server .
Deep proficiency in PySpark , including performance tuning and optimization in large-scale data environments.
Expertise in working with Delta Lake format and cloud-based data lakes , especially OneLake .
Strong skills in T-SQL , KQL , and cloud-based data modeling (e.g., star schema, dimensional modeling).
Understanding of data governance , security , and compliance best practices in Azure.
Experience with version control (Git), automated deployments, and infrastructure as code.
Familiarity with Power BI integration and semantic models in Fabric.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience modernizing ETL/ELT workloads into Microsoft Fabric and lakehouse architectures.
Exposure to real-time streaming data or hybrid batch-stream processing.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Data Engineer Associate ) are a plus.
Power BI Expertise
Deep hands-on experience with Power BI Desktop and Service.
Strong knowledge of Power BI data models (both Import and DirectQuery, DirectLake).
Proficiency in DAX and MDX query writing and optimization.
Experience with Row-Level Security, composite models, and performance tuning.
Advanced MDX and SSAS Knowledge
Experience writing and optimizing MDX queries for performance and readability.
Understanding of multidimensional cubes and their structure.
Comfortable with SSAS Multidimensional and SSAS Tabular models.
Tools and Add-Ons
Tabular Editor: Scripting, managing measures, KPIs, calculation groups, best practice checks.
DAX Studio / MDX Studio: For query optimization, tracing queries, analyzing performance.
ALM Toolkit: For model deployment and comparison/version control.
Familiarity with tools like VertiPaq Analyzer, SQL Profiler for debugging and optimizing Power BI reports.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test, Data Collection Technology
description:
As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), you will be a critical part of our engineering team, responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our software systems. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to build robust test automation frameworks, integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines, and drive a culture of quality across the organization.
You will be expected to be hands-on with AI-augmented testing tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test development and improve coverage. Your role will involve white-box testing, requiring strong coding skills and deep understanding of system internals. You will also be responsible for API testing, and should be well-versed in tools and frameworks such as JUnit, Postman, and REST-assured.
Team Overview
The team s mission is to accelerate time-to-business-value for internal teams building data-driven solutions at PitchBook. By enabling seamless dataset migration to a newly architected pipeline, the team ensures that foundational data infrastructure is robust, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs. This work directly supports the delivery of high-quality solutions relied upon by thousands of PitchBook customers every day.
Working closely with global stakeholders, the team fosters a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement. With a growth mindset, team members are encouraged to deepen their technical expertise and solve everyday challenges in data engineering and pipeline delivery.
Technical stack: Java 17, Docker / Kubernetes, Spring Boot 2.x., Spring Data / Hibernate, REST / OpenAPI, MS SQL / PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, ElasticSearch, TestContainers
Outline of Duties and Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites for backend services, APIs, and front-end applications.
Perform white-box testing by writing and reviewing code to validate internal logic and integration points.
Use AI augmentation tools like GitHub Copilot to enhance productivity and test coverage.
Collaborate with developers and product teams to define test strategies, acceptance criteria, and quality gates.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous validation of code changes.
Develop and execute API tests using tools such as JUnit, Postman, REST-assured, or similar.
Identify, document, and track bugs and issues, and work with engineering teams to resolve them efficiently.
Advocate for engineering excellence and drive adoption of best practices in testing and quality assurance.
Continuously evaluate and improve test coverage, tooling, and processes to enhance team productivity and product quality.
Ownership of the automated QA process. In particular: API tests,e2e tests, Smoke tests, Integration tests.
Automation of regression testing, Automated generation of test data, Gathering and analyzing test reports, Analysis of the existing automation gaps
Helping to identify opportunities for automation. Assisting with / leading the automation review initiative
Experience, Skills, and Qualifications
Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in software testing and automation.
Strong programming skills in Java, Python, or similar languages.
Hands-on experience with JUnit, API testing (REST, OpenAPI, GRPC*) including tools like Swagger / Postman / curl. Practical experience with SQL
Ability to find bottlenecks and thresholds in existing code with the help of automation tools
Strong aptitude for learning new technologies
Familiarity with test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, TestNG, or similar.
Experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile development methodologies.
Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
Would be a plus
Understanding the microservice architecture and cloud solutions
Experience with the UI testing tools and frameworks
Experience with the scripting languages (such as Python)
Experience with the BDD, load and performance testing
Experience with AI-assisted coding
Experience with Kubernetes
Experience with Apache Kafka
Experience with Monitoring / Logging / Grafana / Prometheus / ELK
Working Conditions
The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.
Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer
Morningstars hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as weve found that were at our best when were purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, youll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

title: Engineering Manager, Data Collection Technology
description:
Job Overview
As an Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in enabling a stream-aligned team focused on delivering a successful migration of datasets to a newly architected and designed pipeline. You will work closely with the Lead Software Development Engineer to ensure the team is empowered, autonomous, and aligned with business outcomes. Your leadership will be both strategic and hands-on, contributing directly to the codebase using Java and React.js, while fostering a high-performance engineering culture.
You will be expected to understand and apply microservices architecture principles, and use your experience to guide the team through delivery challenges, architectural decisions, and cross-functional collaboration. Your ability to balance technical depth with team enablement will be key to the success of this initiative.
Team Overview
The team’s mission is to accelerate time-to-business-value for internal teams building data-driven solutions at PitchBook. By enabling seamless dataset migration to a newly architected pipeline, the team ensures that foundational data infrastructure is robust, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs. This work directly supports the delivery of high-quality solutions relied upon by thousands of PitchBook customers every day.
Working closely with global stakeholders, the team fosters a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement. With a growth mindset, team members are encouraged to deepen their technical expertise and solve everyday challenges in data engineering and pipeline delivery. The Engineering Manager will play a key role in guiding this stream-aligned team, ensuring autonomy while providing strategic and hands-on support to meet delivery goals effectively.
Outline of Duties and Responsibilities
Enable and empower stream-aligned teams led by Lead Software Development Engineers (LSDEs), ensuring clear boundaries, autonomy, and alignment with business domains.
Act as a technical enabler, removing impediments, facilitating team flow, and fostering a culture of continuous delivery and improvement.
Roll up sleeves and contribute hands-on to development efforts, especially in Java, React.js, and AI-augmented coding using tools like GitHub Copilot.
Lead and coordinate application enhancement and tech ops activities with technology and business teams.
Participate in architecture discussions, system design, task breakdown, estimation, code reviews, QA, and release planning.
Understand and apply microservices architecture principles to guide scalable and maintainable system design.
Coordinate with stakeholders to create and manage realistic and detailed project schedules.
Identify project risks, develop mitigation plans, and escalate potential impediments to stakeholders for resolution.
Communicate regular updates on project status (e.g., work completed, work in progress, next steps, risks, KPIs) to stakeholders, peers, and product managers.
Collaborate across teams and departments to proactively identify and manage dependencies.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness across engineering practices.
Experience, Skills, and Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's in Engineering or equivalent degree in Computer Science or related field.
Minimum 12+ years of experience in software development and engineering leadership.
Proven experience in Java, J2EE, and front-end development using React.js.
Strong understanding of microservices architecture, including service boundaries, API contracts, and deployment strategies.
Hands-on experience or working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Experience with AI-augmented development tools like GitHub Copilot and a passion for leveraging AI in software engineering.
Strong database knowledge (MS SQL, Oracle, MySQL, etc.).
Keen focus on code quality, design frameworks, and engineering best practices.
Experience in Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
Demonstrated ability to hire, mentor, and lead technical teams, especially in stream-aligned structures.
Experience managing large-scale projects with aggressive timelines and complex scopes.
Excellent communication, time management, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
Ability to foster team decision-making, healthy debate, and collaboration.
Comfort with ambiguity and ability to create clarity and focus for the team.
Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer
Working Conditions
The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

title: Associate Principal Engineer, Data Science
description:
We're Nagarro.

We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (17500+ experts across 39 countries). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We're looking for great new colleagues. That's where you come in!

REQUIREMENTS:
Total experience 11+ years.
Hands on working experience in data science with a focus on predictive modeling and optimization.
Strong working experience with Data Science on GCP, Generative AI fundamentals.
Strong experience with Python (and/or R) and libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch.
Strong knowledge of Cloud Architecture and deployment of data solutions in cloud ecosystems (e.g. Azure, GCP).
Hands on experience with SQL relational databases, and big data ecosystems
Proven expertise in machine learning, mathematical optimization (e.g., LP, IP, genetic algorithms, RL), and NLP techniques.
Familiarity with Generative AI fundamentals and hands-on experience with RAG, Lang Chain, Llama Index, and prompt engineering.
Strong understanding of MLOps principles and tools for CI/CD, monitoring, and model lifecycle management.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Writing and reviewing great quality code
Understanding the client’s business use cases and technical requirements and be able to convert them into technical design which elegantly meets the requirements.
Mapping decisions with requirements and be able to translate the same to developers.
Identifying different solutions and being able to narrow down the best option that meets the clients’ requirements.
Defining guidelines and benchmarks for NFR considerations during project implementation.
Writing and reviewing design document explaining overall architecture, framework, and high-level design of the application for the developers.
Reviewing architecture and design on various aspects like extensibility, scalability, security, design patterns, user experience, NFRs, etc., and ensure that all relevant best practices are followed.
Developing and designing the overall solution for defined functional and non-functional requirements; and defining technologies, patterns, and frameworks to materialize it.
Understanding and relating technology integration scenarios and applying these learnings in projects.
Resolving issues that are raised during code/review, through exhaustive systematic analysis of the root cause, and being able to justify the decision taken.
Carrying out POCs to make sure that suggested design/technologies meet the requirements.
skills: Data Science, Generative Ai, GCP, Machine Learning, Python, Pandas, Cloud Architecture

Hvantage Technologies Inc. is a global provider of advanced software solutions, delivering cutting-edge technology platforms across industries such as Healthcare, Finance, Retail, and Enterprise IT.
Our core strength lies in architecting scalable, high-performance, and secure applications using modern technologies.

We are seeking a Data Engineer with strong expertise in the Azure Data Platform.

This is an immediate joiner position for developers passionate about crafting robust backend systems that drive modern, cloud-native applications.

About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance data pipelines on the Azure Data Platform. This role requires strong hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF), SQL Server, and ETL/ELT frameworks, along with the ability to work with large datasets efficiently.

The ideal candidate will play a critical role in ensuring reliable data ingestion, transformation, validation, and delivery across enterprise systems. You will collaborate closely with analytics, engineering, and business teams to translate complex data requirements into robust, production-ready solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipeline Development & ETL Engineering
Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end ETL/ELT data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF).
Create and manage ADF components such as pipelines, datasets, linked services, triggers, parameters, and control flows.
Implement scalable and fault-tolerant data ingestion workflows from multiple structured and semi-structured data sources.
Ensure pipelines are optimized for reliability, reusability, and maintainability.

SQL Development & Optimization
Develop and maintain SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions, and triggers using SSMS.
Write highly optimized SQL queries for large-scale data processing, analytics, and reporting use cases.
Perform SQL performance tuning, including indexing strategies, query refactoring, execution plan analysis, joins, and subquery optimization.
Monitor and improve query execution times and database performance in production environments.

Big Data & Transformations
Develop and maintain data transformations using PySpark in Azure-based big data environments.
Handle large-volume datasets efficiently using distributed processing techniques.
Support data enrichment, cleansing, and transformation workflows across multiple domains.

Data Quality, Validation & Governance
Implement robust data validation, reconciliation, and error-handling mechanisms.
Ensure adherence to ETL best practices, data governance standards, and coding guidelines.
Support auditability, traceability, and data quality metrics across pipelines.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Collaborate with senior engineers, data analysts, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand and refine data requirements.
Translate business and analytical needs into technical data solutions.
Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Production Support & Troubleshooting
Assist in troubleshooting production issues related to data pipelines and databases.
Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term fixes to prevent recurrence.
Support enhancements, optimizations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Technical Skills

Mandatory Skills
Azure Data Factory (ADF):
Strong hands-on experience with pipelines, datasets, linked services, triggers, parameters, and orchestration.
SQL Server / SSMS:
Advanced SQL development, stored procedures, views, functions, and triggers.
SQL Query Optimization:
Proven expertise in performance tuning, indexing, execution plan analysis, and query best practices.
ETL / ELT Concepts:
Strong understanding of data warehousing principles and ETL/ELT frameworks.

Good to Have Skills
PySpark:
Hands-on experience in data transformations and processing.
Python:
Data processing, scripting, and automation.
Azure Ecosystem:
Familiarity with Azure Synapse, Azure Data Lake, Delta tables, or related services.
Data Modeling:
Basic understanding of star and snowflake schema design.

Soft Skills & Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.
Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

Why Join Us?
Work on large-scale, enterprise-grade data platforms.
Exposure to modern Azure-based data engineering solutions.
Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
Opportunity to work on impactful, data-driven initiatives.

If you are an immediate joiner with the required technical expertise and leadership skills, we invite you to apply for the data engineer role.

Please submit your updated resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience to neelesh@hvantage.com or send over WhatsApp at +917024041115.

Own end-to-end strategy, architecture, and delivery of enterprise data platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Combine solution architecture (data lakehouse/warehouse, streaming, governance) with hands-on engineering (Python, PySpark, Scala) and TPM leadership (road mapping, cross-team coordination, delivery governance). Lead discovery, design, and execution of secure, scalable, and cost-optimized data solutions, mentor teams, and communicate value to senior stakeholders.
Duties and responsibilities of position:
General areas of responsibility relate to:
• Lead discovery workshops; translate business objectives into data platform architectures and outcome-based roadmaps.
Architect GCP-native solutions integrating BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataproc/Spark, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI (as applicable), and IAM. • Define and enforce governance, security, and compliance (RBAC/IAM, data masking, lineage, retention, GDPR/HIPAA/SOC 2).
Establish delivery frameworks: backlog & milestones, RACI, estimation, resourcing, CI/CD, environment management, and operational readiness.
• Drive FinOps and performance optimization: capacity planning, cost monitoring, and efficiency improvements.
• Mentor architects/consultants/engineers; set coding standards, review designs, and guide technical decisions.
• Act as the primary client interface for solution walkthroughs, trade-off analysis, risk management, and executive updates.
Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to:
• Design lakehouse/warehouse architectures: Cloud Storage Dataproc/Spark BigQuery (ELT), with curated zones (bronze/silver/gold).
Define streaming patterns using Pub/Sub + Dataflow / Spark Structured Streaming; implement CDC via connectors/Debezium (if applicable).
• Select the right compute engines (Dataproc vs. Dataflow vs. BigQuery SQL), storage formats (Parquet/Delta/Iceberg), and workload isolation. • Lead development of modular pipelines in PySpark/Scala (Dataproc) and Python utilities/APIs; enforce packaging, logging, testing.
Implement SCD Type 1/Type 2 and CDC (watermarks, MERGE/upsert strategies); handle schema evolution & late-arriving data.
• Optimize Spark workloads (partitioning, predicate pushdown, broadcast joins, shuffle tuning, checkpointing); remediate small-file issues. • Model star/snowflake schemas, conformed dimensions, and KPI-aligned fact tables; define semantic consistency and data contracts. • Tune BigQuery: table partitioning/clustering, materialized views, query plan review, BI integration (Looker/Power BI/Tableau).
• Implement IAM/RBAC, VPC-SC, CMEK (encryption keys), DLP (where applicable), row/column-level security in BigQuery.
Establish catalogue/lineage (Data Catalogue, Looker semantic layer, or third-party), tagging/classification, retention & legal hold policies.
• Set up Git-based workflows and CI/CD (Cloud Build / GitHub Actions) for Spark jobs, Python packages, SQL/dbt models, and infra.

title: Data Architect
description:
Job purpose:
Own end-to-end strategy, architecture, and delivery of enterprise data platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Combine solution architecture (data lakehouse/warehouse, streaming, governance) with hands-on engineering (Python, PySpark, Scala) and TPM leadership (road mapping, cross-team coordination, delivery governance). Lead discovery, design, and execution of secure, scalable, and cost-optimized data solutions, mentor teams, and communicate value to senior stakeholders.
Duties and responsibilities of position:
General areas of responsibility relate to:
• Lead discovery workshops; translate business objectives into data platform architectures and outcome-based roadmaps.
Architect GCP-native solutions integrating BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataproc/Spark, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI (as applicable), and IAM. • Define and enforce governance, security, and compliance (RBAC/IAM, data masking, lineage, retention, GDPR/HIPAA/SOC 2).
Establish delivery frameworks: backlog & milestones, RACI, estimation, resourcing, CI/CD, environment management, and operational readiness.
• Drive FinOps and performance optimization: capacity planning, cost monitoring, and efficiency improvements.
• Mentor architects/consultants/engineers; set coding standards, review designs, and guide technical decisions.
• Act as the primary client interface for solution walkthroughs, trade-off analysis, risk management, and executive updates.
Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to:
• Design lakehouse/warehouse architectures: Cloud Storage Dataproc/Spark BigQuery (ELT), with curated zones (bronze/silver/gold).
Define streaming patterns using Pub/Sub + Dataflow / Spark Structured Streaming; implement CDC via connectors/Debezium (if applicable).
• Select the right compute engines (Dataproc vs. Dataflow vs. BigQuery SQL), storage formats (Parquet/Delta/Iceberg), and workload isolation. • Lead development of modular pipelines in PySpark/Scala (Dataproc) and Python utilities/APIs; enforce packaging, logging, testing.
Implement SCD Type 1/Type 2 and CDC (watermarks, MERGE/upsert strategies); handle schema evolution & late-arriving data.
• Optimize Spark workloads (partitioning, predicate pushdown, broadcast joins, shuffle tuning, checkpointing); remediate small-file issues. • Model star/snowflake schemas, conformed dimensions, and KPI-aligned fact tables; define semantic consistency and data contracts. • Tune BigQuery: table partitioning/clustering, materialized views, query plan review, BI integration (Looker/Power BI/Tableau).
• Implement IAM/RBAC, VPC-SC, CMEK (encryption keys), DLP (where applicable), row/column-level security in BigQuery.
Establish catalogue/lineage (Data Catalogue, Looker semantic layer, or third-party), tagging/classification, retention & legal hold policies.
• Set up Git-based workflows and CI/CD (Cloud Build / GitHub Actions) for Spark jobs, Python packages, SQL/dbt models, and infra.
Use Terraform/Deployment Manager for IaC (projects, IAM, networking, data services); define promotion gates (devtestprod), secrets/variables, rollback/DR.
• Build telemetry & dashboards: pipeline SLAs/SLOs, freshness/latency, failure rates; set alerts and lead RCA.
• Optimize compute/storage cost: autoscaling, spot/preemptible workers, reservation planning, lifecycle policies, usage tagging; forecast and track budgets.
Other duties:
Own program planning: multi-quarter roadmaps, dependency mapping, interface agreements across app/BI/security/network teams.
• Run governance ceremonies (steerco, risk reviews, change control), drive decisions, and manage stakeholder communication.
Ensure delivery against milestones with quality gates, non-functional requirements, and compliance checklists.
Lead POCs to validate architecture decisions (streaming throughput, SCD2 performance, BigQuery optimization, governance integration).
• Contribute to proposals, SOWs, and effort models; support pre-sales and solution accelerators.
• Produce executive reports on platform health, risk posture, compliance, and cost; socialize best practices company-wide.
• Provide after-hours support for critical incidents/releases on a rotational basis.
Qualifications:
Education: Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience).
• Experience: 810 years in data engineering/analytics; 4+ years architecting on GCP; proven TPM/lead experience.
• Technical Expertise:
GCP: BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataproc (Spark), Dataflow (Beam), Pub/Sub, Composer (Airflow), Cloud Functions, IAM, VPC-SC; Terraform/IaC.
Languages: Python, PySpark, Scala (DataFrames/Spark SQL/Structured Streaming); packaging, testing (pytest), performance profiling. o Patterns: CDC/SCD1/SCD2, medallion/lakehouse, ELT in BigQuery, schema evolution, data contracts.
Modelling & Tuning: star/snowflake, clustering/partitioning, materialized views, caching, query optimization (Spark & BigQuery).
Security/Governance: IAM/RBAC, encryption keys (CMEK), DLP/classification, catalogue/lineage, compliance (GDPR/HIPAA/SOC 2).

Leading workshops, authoring HLD/LLD, trade-off analysis, and change management.
Mentoring and cross-team leadership; enforcing delivery discipline and quality gates.
Executive-grade communication and the ability to simplify complex technical topics for business stakeholders.

The Senior Data Engineer is an advanced subject matter expert, accountable for the transformation of data into a structured format that can be easily analyzed in a query or report.

Ensure feature lineage and traceability back to source systems

Support multi-cloud data architectures across Azure, AWS, and GCP

Support lineage, auditability, and traceability in collaboration with governance teams
Prepare data assets to support Responsible AI and regulatory compliance initiatives

Collaborate with GenAI & Data Solution Architects, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Backend and Platform Engineers, QA, and Delivery teams

description:
Ethoca, a Mastercard Company is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our team in Pune, India to drive data enablement and explore big data solutions within our technology landscape. The role is visible and critical as part of a high performing team it will appeal to you if you have an effective combination of domain knowledge, relevant experience and the ability to execute on the details.
You will bring cutting edge software and full stack development skills with advanced knowledge of cloud and data lake experience while working with massive data volumes. You will own this our teams are small, agile and focused on the needs of the high growth fintech marketplace.

Plan and own deployments, migrations, and upgrades across data platforms and pipelines to minimize service impacts, including developing and executing mitigation plans.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver reliable, high-impact data solutions.
Document pipeline architecture, processes, and standards, promoting consistency and transparency across the team.
Apply exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills to troubleshoot complex data and system issues.

Tenured in the fields of Computer Science/Engineering or Software Engineering.

Deep hands-on experience with Snowflake/Data Bricks (including administration), Snowpark, and Python.

Proficient in CI/CD tooling, especially GitLab and Jenkins, with a focus on automation and DataOps.
Experience with real-time data processing and streaming pipelines.
Strong grasp of cloud-based database infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Skilled in developing insightful dashboards and scalable data models using Power BI.
Expert in SQL development and performance optimization.
Demonstrated success in building and maintaining data observability tools and frameworks.
Proven ability to plan and execute deployments, upgrades, and migrations with minimal disruption to operations.
Strong communication, collaboration, and analytical thinking across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ideally you have experience in banking, e-commerce, credit cards or payment processing and exposure to both SaaS and premises-based architectures. In addition, you have a post-secondary degree in computer science, mathematics, or quantitative science.

- Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.

- Ability to work independently and manage tasks effectively in a remote environment.

- Adaptability to different cultural norms and communication styles within a global team.

- Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

- 5-10 years of professional experience as a Data Engineer with a focus on SAP BW/4HANA.

- Proven track record of successful implementation and support of SAP BW/4HANA data
solutions.

- Strong understanding of data warehousing principles and best practices.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills in an international environment.

Bonus Points :

- SAP BW/4HANA certification.

- Experience with other data warehousing technologies.

- Knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and its integration with SAP BW/4HANA.

- Experience with agile development methodologies

Optimize data workflows for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

Advanced SQL skills for data manipulation and optimization.

title: Senior LLM Engineer - Data Modeling
description:
Position Overview :

We are seeking an experienced NLP & LLM Specialist to join our team.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in working with transformer-based models, including GPT, BERT, T5, RoBERTa, and similar models.

This role requires experience in fine-tuning these pre-trained models on domain-specific tasks, as well as crafting and optimizing prompts for natural language processing tasks such as text generation, summarization, question answering, classification, and translation.

The candidate should be proficient in Python and familiar with NLP libraries like Hugging Face, SpaCy, and NLTK, with a solid understanding of model evaluation metrics.

Roles and Responsibilities :

- Model Expertise : Work with transformer models such as GPT, BERT, T5, RoBERTa, and others for a variety of NLP tasks, including text generation, summarization, classification, and translation.

- Model Fine-Tuning : Fine-tune pre-trained models on domain-specific datasets to improve performance for specific applications such as summarization, text generation, and question answering.

- Prompt Engineering : Craft clear, concise, and contextually relevant prompts to guide transformer-based models towards generating desired outputs for specific tasks.

- Iterate on prompts to optimize model performance.

- Instruction-Based Prompting : Implement instruction-based prompting to guide the model toward achieving specific goals, ensuring that the outputs are contextually accurate and aligned with task objectives.

- Zero-shot, Few-shot, Many-shot Learning : Utilize zero-shot, few-shot, and many-shot learning techniques to improve model performance without the need for full retraining.

- Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Prompting : Implement Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting to guide models through complex reasoning tasks, ensuring that the outputs are logically structured and provide step-by-step explanations.

- Model Evaluation : Use evaluation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, and other relevant metrics to assess and improve the performance of models for various NLP tasks.

- Model Deployment : Support the deployment of trained models into production environments and integrate them into existing systems for real-time applications.

- Bias Awareness : Be aware of and mitigate issues related to bias, hallucinations, and knowledge cutoffs in LLMs, ensuring high-quality and reliable outputs.

- Collaboration : Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineers, data scientists, and product managers to deliver efficient and scalable NLP solutions.

Must Have Skill :

- Overall 7 years with at least 5+ years of experience working with transformer-based models and NLP tasks, with a focus on text generation, summarization, question answering, classification, and similar tasks.

- Expertise in transformer models like GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer), BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers), T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer), RoBERTa, and similar models.

- Familiarity with model architectures, attention mechanisms, and self-attention layers that enable LLMs to generate human-like text.

- Experience in fine-tuning pre-trained models on domain-specific datasets for tasks such as text generation, summarization, question answering, classification, and translation.

- Familiarity with concepts like attention mechanisms, context windows, tokenization, and embedding layers.

- Awareness of biases, hallucinations, and knowledge cutoffs that can affect LLM performance and output quality.

- Expertise in crafting clear, concise, and contextually relevant prompts to guide LLMs towards generating desired outputs.

- Experience in instruction-based prompting.

- Use of zero-shot, few-shot, and many-shot learning techniques for maximizing model performance without retraining.

- Experience in iterating on prompts to refine outputs, test model performance, and ensure consistent results.

- Crafting prompt templates for repetitive tasks, ensuring prompts are adaptable to different contexts and inputs.

- Expertise in chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting to guide LLMs through complex reasoning tasks by encouraging step-by-step breakdowns.

- Proficiency in Python and experience with NLP libraries (e.g., Hugging Face, SpaCy, NLTK).

- Experience with transformer-based models (e.g., GPT, BERT, T5) for text generation tasks.

- Experience in training, fine-tuning, and deploying machine learning models in an NLP context.

- Understanding of model evaluation metrics (e.g., BLEU, ROUGE).

Qualification :

- BE/B.Tech or Equivalent degree in Computer Science or related field.

- Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.

description:
Role Purpose
The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
Do
1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
2. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
3. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities:
1. Model Development and Training
Building and Training Models: Design, build, and train machine learning and deep learning models to solve complex business problems. This could include tasks like prediction, classification, anomaly detection, and natural language processing (NLP).
Experimentation: Run experiments to compare different machine learning models and algorithms (e.g., linear regression, decision trees, neural networks) and evaluate their performance.
Model Optimization: Fine-tune models, optimizing hyperparameters to improve accuracy, speed, and efficiency. Work on techniques like Grid Search, Random Search, or Bayesian Optimization to improve model performance.
2. Data Preparation and Preprocessing
Data Wrangling: Clean and preprocess large datasets by handling missing values, outliers, and inconsistencies, and transforming raw data into usable formats for machine learning.
Feature Engineering: Identify and create the most relevant features from raw data that will be used in models, ensuring optimal performance.
Data Augmentation: Use techniques like data augmentation to expand datasets, especially for tasks like computer vision or NLP.
3. Model Evaluation and Validation
Metrics Evaluation: Evaluate machine learning models using appropriate metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, AUC-ROC, etc.
Cross-Validation: Use techniques like k-fold cross-validation to validate the model and ensure it generalizes well to new, unseen data.
Bias and Fairness Check: Monitor models for biases and ensure they are fair and accurate across different groups.
4. Model Deployment and Scaling
Deployment: Deploy machine learning models to production environments, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with software systems, applications, or APIs.
Model Versioning: Use version control for models (e.g., MLflow) to manage changes and keep track of different versions of models over time.
Automation and Pipeline Development: Automate the process of training, testing, and deploying models using tools like Airflow, Kubeflow, or ML Ops practices.
Monitoring and Maintenance: Continuously monitor deployed models to ensure they perform as expected in real-time. Implement logging, alerting, and re-training mechanisms as necessary.
5. Collaboration and Communication
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, product managers, and business analysts to understand the business needs, gather requirements, and deliver AI/ML solutions that meet those needs.
Stakeholder Communication: Present findings and model results to non-technical stakeholders, explaining the model's impact on business goals and providing actionable insights.
Documentation: Write detailed documentation for models, data pipelines, and AI solutions to ensure transparency and reproducibility. This includes documenting the algorithms used, assumptions, and performance metrics.


Preferred candidate profile:
1. Educational Qualifications
Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a related field.
Master's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Artificial Intelligence (optional but often preferred for more advanced roles).
Certifications in machine learning, AI, or cloud computing from reputable platforms (e.g., Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer).
2. Technical Skills - Machine Learning and Deep Learning:
Strong experience with supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning algorithms.
Expertise in deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or MXNet.
Hands-on experience with advanced ML algorithms such as decision trees, random forests, SVMs, gradient boosting, and deep learning architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs).
3. Programming Languages:
Proficiency in Python (primary language for AI/ML), including libraries like NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
Familiarity with R (for statistical analysis) and SQL (for querying databases).
Experience with C++ or Java is optional but can be beneficial in performance-intensive AI/ML applications.
4. Data Engineering:
Solid experience in data preprocessing, feature engineering, and data wrangling.
Proficiency with Big Data tools like Spark, Hadoop, or Dask for handling large datasets.
Understanding of data pipelines and workflow automation using tools like Apache Airflow or Kubeflow.
5. Cloud Computing:
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure for deploying AI models in production.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based AI/ML services like AWS SageMaker, Google AI Platform, or Azure Machine Learning.
6. Model Deployment:
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines for deploying machine learning models in production.
Familiarity with model-serving tools like TensorFlow Serving, FastAPI, or Flask for building APIs around ML models.
7. Software Engineering Practices:
Strong software engineering skills, including writing clean, maintainable, and testable code.
Version control with Git for collaboration on codebases.
Knowledge of DevOps practices and automating the deployment of AI/ML models.
8. Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to break down complex business problems and apply machine learning techniques effectively.
Ability to translate business needs into AI/ML solutions that are scalable, interpretable, and impactful.

description:
Thank you for considering the Healthcare Data Quality Analyst position at Reveal Health Tech. We are a Series A stage IT startup based in the US and India, delivering technology-driven solutions for the healthcare and life sciences industry as we scale toward our next phase of growth.
About the Role
Were looking for a Healthcare Data Quality Analyst who ensures that healthcare data is accurate, timely, and contract-grade. You ll define data quality rules, reconcile across disparate sources, operationalize validation processes, and partner with provider groups, specialty groups, payers, and internal product teams to make sure analytic outputs can be trusted for clinical operations, financial performance reporting, and value-based care programs. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare data operations, quality engineering, and compliance and plays a critical part in enabling downstream analytics, actuarial evaluations, and performance benchmarking.
What You ll Do
Data Quality Engineering: Develop, maintain, and automate data validation checks across claims, eligibility, EMR, and care management data.
Reconciliation & Accuracy: Reconcile payer rosters, attribution files, and eligibility against claims and EMR data to ensure patient and cohort accuracy.
Standards & Rule Definitions: Define quality rules for accuracy, completeness, timeliness, conformity, and uniqueness mapped to business logic and regulatory requirements.
Root Cause Analysis: Investigate data anomalies, ingestion failures, missingness patterns, mismatched identifiers, and lineage gaps; document root cause and corrective actions.
Metadata & Lineage: Maintain source-to-target mapping, lineage documentation, and metric definition dictionaries with data engineering and analytics teams.
Contract & Program Support: Ensure data meets quality thresholds for actuarial and contract performance use cases such as shared savings reconciliation and risk measurement.
Provider & Payer Partnership: Collaborate with providers, payers, and vendors on file specifications, corrections, protocols, and reconciliation cadence.
Data Onboarding & Integration: QA new data feeds (claims, eligibility, EMR extracts) to confirm conformity to specifications and downstream readiness.
Governance & Controls: Contribute to data governance frameworks, access controls, and audit trails aligned with HIPAA, HITRUST, and internal standards.
Minimum Qualifications
3+ years in healthcare data quality, healthcare data operations, data engineering, or health informatics.
Experience validating claims/eligibility (837/835 structures, CPT/HCPCS/ICD-10), NPI/taxonomy, and payer/provider data.
SQL proficiency (joins, window functions, CTEs) and comfort with large relational datasets.
Experience reconciling payer attribution and roster data with eligibility and claims.

Strong problem decomposition, documentation, and cross-team communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with HL7/FHIR, CCD/CCDA, or EMR integration patterns.
Python (pandas) or R for data validation scripting.
Exposure to ETL/ELT tooling (dbt, ADF, SSIS, Informatica, etc.).
Cloud data platforms (Azure Synapse/SQL, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift).
Experience contributing to or operating within data governance frameworks.

Validation: SQL, Python (pandas), dbt (testing), Great Expectations (optional)

description:
Company Overview
At Prosperity Behavioral Health, we understand the unique challenges faced by behavioral health providers and are committed to providing innovative solutions that streamline operations and enhance financial performance. By leveraging our advanced technology and industry expertise, we enable our customers to focus on providing life-changing care to those in need.
We simplify financial and billing complexity to accelerate business results and unlock patient growth.
Our mission is to transform the business side of behavioral health, allowing providers to navigate the complexities of the healthcare landscape with confidence. Whether its optimizing revenue cycles, improving operational efficiency, or ensuring compliance with industry standards, Prosperity Behavioral Health supports our customers every step of the way.
Join us in making a meaningful impact in the lives of countless individuals. At Prosperity Behavioral Health, you will be part of a dynamic team dedicated to driving positive change and helping our customers thrive in an ever-evolving industry.
General Purpose of Position
We are looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to join our team and lead the construction of our next-generation Data Lake and Data Product platform. In this role, you will be responsible for architecting and implementing scalable data pipelines that gather and transform raw data into high-value business insights.
You will be building a Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) from the ground up, utilizing a modern AWS stack. This is a "builder" role ideal for someone who enjoys writing infrastructure as code, optimizing distributed systems, and treating data as a product.
Primary Responsibilities (include but are not limited to)
Pipeline Development & Architecture
Build the Medallion Architecture: Design and implement the Bronze (Raw), Silver (Cleansed/Conformed), and Gold (Aggregated/Curated) layers of the data lake to ensure data quality and lineage.
Big Data Processing: Develop high-performance distributed data processing jobs using Apache Spark on AWS EMR to handle large-scale transformations.
Ingestion Services: Write and maintain Python-based ingestion scripts containerized via Docker and deployed on AWS ECS Fargate to fetch data from third-party sources such as sFTP locations and web portals via browser automation.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps
Infrastructure Management: Define and deploy all AWS infrastructure (S3 buckets, IAM roles, EMR clusters, ECS tasks) using AWS CDK (Cloud Development Kit).
CI/CD Integration: Maintain deployment pipelines to ensure safe, automated rollouts of infrastructure and code changes.
Data Quality & Governance
Data Product Focus: collaborate with product managers and analysts to treat data tables as "products," ensuring they meet SLAs for freshness, accuracy, and availability.
Optimization: Tune Spark jobs and ECS tasks for cost-efficiency and performance.
Monitoring: Implement logging and alerting to ensure pipeline health and rapid incident response.
Education, Skills and Experience Requirements
Education
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
Required Experience (Must-Haves)
3+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Backend Software Engineering.
Advanced Python Proficiency: Strong object-oriented programming skills for writing modular ingestion scripts and CDK constructs.
Spark & Big Data: Proven experience optimizing Apache Spark jobs for memory management and partitioning (experience with EMR or Databricks preferred).
AWS Ecosystem: Deep familiarity with core AWS data services, specifically S3, EMR, and IAM.
Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience with AWS CDK (preferred), Terraform, or CloudFormation. You should be comfortable defining infrastructure programmatically.
Containerization: Experience writing Dockerfiles and managing containerized workloads on ECS or Kubernetes.
Preferred Skills (Nice-to-Haves)
Experience implementing the Medallion Architecture
Knowledge of open table formats like Apache Iceberg
Experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., AWS Step Functions, Apache Airflow, or Dagster)
Familiarity with SQL and data warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, or Athena)

Communicate technical concepts related to AI/ML models, cloud infrastructure, and MLOps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience building, training, and deploying Generative AI models and other complex AI solutions.

Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and the ability to architect machine learning systems in AWS.

The vision of Risk Data Analytics Hub is to establish a data-centric risk function that is forward-thinking, resilient, and proactive. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment, promoting innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the team.

title: Power Platform Developer
description:
Job Description:
Job Title: Senior Power Platform Developer
Reports to: VP, Head of Data, Technology & Analytics
Location: Remote Global (must be available through 2 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time)
Employment Type: Full-time Long-term Contract (Annual Renewal)
Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Power Platform Developer to join our team. This role is critical to the development and operation of enterprise applications that power business process automation, data analytics, and digital transformation initiatives across our organization.
As a Senior Power Platform Developer, you will architect, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and optimized solutions using Microsoft Power Apps, Dataverse, and integration with Azure services. Your focus will be on developing robust canvas and model-driven apps, automated workflows, data models, and API integrations that drive operational efficiency and business insights. Youll operate in a fast-paced environment, supporting innovation across cross-functional teams and ensuring reliability, governance, and performance in all solutions.
You will work hands-on with the Microsoft Power Platform suite, Azure cloud services, and modern ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) practices including version control and CI/CD pipelines. This role requires someone who can independently build full enterprise applications from scratch while partnering seamlessly with Power BI developers, backend developers, data engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
Power Apps Development & Application Architecture
Design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade Power Apps solutions including canvas apps and model-driven apps.
Architect multi-layered applications with proper separation of concerns using components, component libraries, and reusable patterns.
Develop complex Power Fx formulas for business logic, data manipulation, validation, and user experience optimization.
Build responsive and accessible user interfaces following Microsoft Fluent Design principles and UX best practices.
Implement custom connectors for integration with third-party REST APIs and services not available in standard connectors.
Design data models in Dataverse with custom tables, relationships, choice columns, calculated fields, and rollup fields.
Translate business and stakeholder requirements into scalable, efficient Power Platform solutions that are maintainable and secure.
Dataverse & Data Architecture
Design and implement Dataverse data models.
Configure table properties including ownership (user/organization), audit settings, change tracking, and duplicate detection.
Build business rules, calculated fields, rollup fields, and virtual tables for advanced data logic.
Create and manage security roles, column-level security, and hierarchical security models.
Design and implement solution architecture with proper layering, dependencies, and managed/unmanaged solution strategies.
Integrate Dataverse with external systems using Azure Synapse Link, dataflows (Power Query), or custom API integrations.
Work with Microsoft Lists and SharePoint for lightweight data storage and integrate with Power Apps and Power Automate.
Azure Integration & API Development
Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure services including Azure Functions, Logic Apps and API Management.
Build custom APIs using Azure Functions for business logic not achievable through Power Platform alone.
Work with Azure SQL Database for external data storage and complex query requirements.
Utilize Azure Key Vault for secure credential and secret management in Power Platform connections.
Implement Azure Active Directory (Azure AD/Entra ID) for authentication, conditional access, and SSO integrations.
Data Integration & Power Query
Create dataflows using Power Query (M language) for ETL processes into Dataverse or Azure Data Lake.
Build data transformation and cleansing logic for ingesting data from multiple sources.
Design incremental refresh strategies for large datasets and optimize data loading performance.
Integrate with Power BI semantic models and support collaboration with Power BI developers.
Build connectors and integration patterns for external data sources including REST APIs, SQL databases, and file-based systems.
Governance, Security & ALM
Implement Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) using solutions, environment strategies (dev/test/prod), and deployment pipelines.
Establish source control practices using GitHub for solution components.
Implement security best practices including least privilege access, environment security groups, and connector governance.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies, industry regulations (GDPR), and Microsoft best practices.
Build monitoring solutions to track solution usage, performance metrics, and user activity.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders including business analysts, Power BI developers, data engineers, backend developers, and business users.
Effectively communicate technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders with clear documentation and demonstrations.
Gather requirements and translate business needs into technical specifications and solution designs.
Conduct user training sessions, create user guides, and provide ongoing support for deployed solutions.
Manage multiple concurrent projects, shifting priorities quickly and delivering under tight timelines.
Qualifications & Certifications
Education
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience
Minimum 5+ years in software development or business applications with 3+ years of hands-on experience in Power Platform development.
Proven track record of building and deploying production Power Apps solutions (canvas and model-driven) from requirements to deployment.
Strong experience with Dataverse including custom tables, business rules, security roles, and data modeling.
Experience with Azure services including Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Azure SQL, and Azure Active Directory (Entra ID).
Advanced skills in Power Fx formulas, M language (Power Query), and understanding of delegation for performance optimization.
Strong portfolio of production solutions demonstrating technical depth, scalability, and business impact.
Certifications
Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400) preferred.
Microsoft Certified: Power Platform App Maker Associate (PL-100) or Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate (PL-200) preferred.
Key Skills
Mandatory Technical Skills
Expert-level Power Apps development with deep understanding of canvas apps, model-driven apps, component libraries, and responsive design patterns.
Advanced Power Fx formula language including collections, context variables, delegation, performance optimization, and complex business logic.
Proficiency in Dataverse including custom tables, relationships, choice columns, calculated/rollup fields, business rules, and security roles.
Strong understanding of column-level security, hierarchical security, and role-based access control (RBAC) in Dataverse.
Hands-on experience with custom connector development for REST APIs including authentication (OAuth 2.0, API Key) and policy definitions.
Proficiency with Power Query (M language) for building dataflows and data transformation logic.
Experience with Microsoft Lists and SharePoint Online integration including document libraries, lists, and content types.
Understanding of Azure Active Directory (Azure AD/Entra ID) for authentication, security groups, conditional access, and SSO.
Nice-to-Have Skills
Power BI fundamentals including report creation, basic DAX measures, and semantic model concepts for collaboration with Power BI developers.
Experience with Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) for building code components using TypeScript and React.
Knowledge of Dataverse plug-in development using C# and the Dataverse SDK for server-side business logic.
Familiarity with Azure Logic Apps for advanced enterprise integration patterns.
Experience with Azure API Management for API gateway and management scenarios.
Knowledge of Microsoft Graph API for programmatic access to Microsoft 365 services.
Soft Skills
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with solution architecture mindset.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive and adaptable, with a continuous learning mindset for evolving Microsoft technologies.
Self-directed and able to work independently on complex projects from requirements gathering to production deployment.
Ability to work effectively within a collaborative, distributed team across time zones.
Ownership mindset with accountability for solution performance, reliability, and user satisfaction.
Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration in fast-paced business environments.
Strong attention to detail for solution quality, testing, documentation, and governance compliance.
Working Hours
Must be available for real-time collaboration with U.S. stakeholders every business day through 2 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time (minimum 4-hour overlap).

Permanent

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the Team
Data is at the core of Outreachs strategy. It drives our product and our customers to the highest levels of success. We use it to derive customer health scores and revenue dashboards, monitor operational metrics of our AWS infrastructure, increase product engagement and user productivity through natural language understanding, and power predictive insights and causal inference via experimentation. As our customer base continues to grow, we are looking towards new ways of leveraging our data to deeper understand our customers needs and deliver new products and features to help continuously improve their customer engagement workflows.

The Business Systems Data Engineering team is on a mission to bring relevant data to every person at Outreach while advancing the use of data and promoting an insight-centric culture. We are a centralized resource providing a suite of services to Outreach business functions across Finance, Analytics, and Support systems, with data as the critical component to a seamless experience.

The group is responsible for offering data serving infrastructure spanning across data warehouse analytics, streaming analytics and search capabilities. You will guide our investments and strategy while making our systems reliable, secure, and a delight to use. Staff Engineers at Stripe are expected and empowered to operate autonomously and are counted on to help drive Stripe forward. In this role, you will work closely and frequently with the other tech staff & senior leadership across Stripes data platform and have opportunities to significantly influence the overall data strategy for Stripe. Were looking for people with a strong background and demonstrated leadership in data platform technologies.

Scope and lead large technical projects with enormous impact for Engineers & business within Stripe.
Build and maintain the infrastructure which powers the core of Stripe.

Work effectively cross functionally.
